2. Draw the outer frame as a rectangle with no fill and a 2-3 px stroke of #B00000 at normalized coordinates [0.016, 0.046, 0.984, 0.951].
3. Draw the plot area as a white (#FFFFFF) rectangle at [0.231, 0.124, 0.777, 0.874] with black (#000000) spines and tick marks.
4. Place x-axis tick labels left-to-right with exact text "0", "5", "10", "15", "20", "25", "30", "35"; center each under its tick in black sans-serif ~10-11 pt.
5. Place y-axis tick labels top-to-bottom with exact text "40", "30", "20", "10", "0", "-10"; right-align each in black sans-serif ~10-11 pt.
6. Render a filled contour decision surface inside the plot area: blue #1F4FD8 on the left/top-left, red #E02424 on the right/top-right, and a gray #C4C4C4 band densely dithered with #0A0A0A dots; add nested inner rings alternating red/blue around a small white wedge near [0.490, 0.545, 0.515, 0.575].
7. Overlay a scatter plot with two unlabeled classes along the spiral using blue #1F4FD8 dots and red #E02424 dots.
8. Draw a black (#000000) arrow at [0.486, 0.548, 0.563, 0.566] pointing left-to-right (increasing x), from data coordinates approximately (16, 11) to (21.5, 11).
9. Draw a pale-yellow ellipse badge at [0.925, 0.072, 0.982, 0.170] with fill #F2F0A6 and thin outline #5A5A5A; center the exact text "47" inside in black medium/bold sans-serif ~18 pt.
10. Draw a full-width black (#000000) rectangle player bar at [0.000, 0.965, 1.000, 1.000].
